audit_items.proof_trace: FFT-based polynomial recovery is implemented in external rust-kzg library (grandinetech/rust-kzg.git), not in Grandine codebase. Grandine's recover_cells_and_kzg_proofs is a thin wrapper that dispatches to backend-specific implementations in the external library. Mathematical equivalence between FFT and Lagrange interpolation cannot be verified within Grandine.
